add-filled-arc-to-pdf-graph.title: Add Filled Arc to PDF Graph
add-filled-arc-to-pdf-graph.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF document, adding a Graph container, drawing an Arc shape, filling it with a custom color, and saving the file.

add-unfilled-arc-with-custom-stroke.title: Add Unfilled Dashed Arc to PDF Graph
add-unfilled-arc-with-custom-stroke.description: Shows how to create a Graph, add an unfilled Arc shape, configure its line width and dash pattern, and save the result as a PDF.

add-filled-circle-to-pdf-graph.title: Add Filled Circle to PDF Using Aspose.Pdf
add-filled-circle-to-pdf-graph.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF document and draw a filled circle by defining its bounding rectangle and styling it with fill and border colors.

create-bezier-curve-in-pdf-graph.title: Create Bezier Curve in PDF with Aspose.Pdf
create-bezier-curve-in-pdf-graph.description: Demonstrates how to draw a cubic Bezier curve using four control points in a PDF document and set its stroke color and line width with Aspose.Pdf.

draw-straight-line-in-pdf-graph.title: Draw Straight Line with Simulated Rounded Caps in PDF Graph
draw-straight-line-in-pdf-graph.description: Creates a PDF document, adds a Graph container, draws a straight line between two points and simulates rounded line caps by placing circles at the line ends.

add-multi-colored-line-segments-to-pdf-g.title: Add Colored Continuous Line Segments to a PDF Graph
add-multi-colored-line-segments-to-pdf-g.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF document, add a Graph, and draw multiple line segments with different colors to represent a continuous data series.

add-rounded-rectangle-with-fill-to-pdf-g.title: Insert Rounded Rectangle into PDF Graph with Fill Color
add-rounded-rectangle-with-fill-to-pdf-g.description: Shows how to create a PDF, add a Graph container, draw a rectangle with rounded corners, apply a solid fill color and border, and save the document.

add-filled-rectangle-with-dashed-border.title: Add Filled Rectangle with Dashed Border to a PDF Graph
add-filled-rectangle-with-dashed-border.description: The example creates a PDF document, adds a Graph container, and draws a rectangle with a light gray fill and a black dashed border, demonstrating how to set fill color, border color, line width, and dash pattern using Aspose.Pdf.

add-ellipse-to-pdf-page.title: Create Ellipse in PDF Graph with Custom Radii and Stroke Color
add-ellipse-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to add a Graph to a PDF page and draw an ellipse with specified horizontal and vertical radii, setting the stroke color to blue while keeping the fill transparent.

add-centered-graph-to-pdf-page.title: Add Centered Bar Chart Graph to PDF Page
add-centered-graph-to-pdf-page.description: Loads an existing PDF, creates a Graph containing a simple bar chart, centers it on the page using alignment properties, adds the graph to the page's Paragraphs collection, and saves the modified document.

align-graph-to-left-margin-pdf.title: Add Graph Aligned to Left Margin with Offset
align-graph-to-left-margin-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a Graph into an existing PDF, position it relative to the left margin using a configurable offset, and draw a simple column chart with lines and rectangles.

set-graph-dimensions-pdf.title: Create a Graph with Specific Width and Height
set-graph-dimensions-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to set the exact width and height of a Graph object in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, position it on a page, and add a simple shape.

create-dimension-line-in-pdf-graph.title: Create a Dimension Line in a PDF Graph
create-dimension-line-in-pdf-graph.description: Shows how to add a Graph to a PDF page and draw a dimension‑specific line with a caption using Aspose.Pdf.

create-dimension-specific-rectangle-pdf.title: Add a Dimension‑Specific Rectangle to a PDF Graph
create-dimension-specific-rectangle-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a Graph that spans the page, drawing a rectangle with explicit dimensions and styling, and saving the modified document.

check-adjust-shape-bounds-pdf.title: Adjust Shape Bounds Within PDF Pages
check-adjust-shape-bounds-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through PDF pages, locate rectangle shapes, check their bounds against the page size, and reposition them so they stay inside the page.

iterate-graph-shapes-bounding-boxes.title: Iterate Graph Shapes and Log Bounding Boxes
iterate-graph-shapes-bounding-boxes.description: Loads a PDF, walks through each page's Graph objects, extracts the bounding box of each shape (rectangles, ellipses, circles, arcs) and writes the coordinates to the console.

rotate-graph-in-pdf.title: Rotate a Graph Element in a PDF
rotate-graph-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, create a Graph with a rectangle shape, apply a rotation angle, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

translate-graph-position-in-pdf.title: Translate Graph Element in PDF
translate-graph-position-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to reposition a Graph object on a PDF page by setting its Left and Top properties, and adds a rectangle shape inside the graph.

non-uniform-scale-graph.title: Non‑Uniform Graph Scaling in PDF
non-uniform-scale-graph.description: Demonstrates how to create a simple graph in a PDF and apply different scaling factors on the X and Y axes using Aspose.Pdf.

skew-graph-x-axis.title: Skew Graph Element on X Axis in PDF
skew-graph-x-axis.description: Shows how to create a Graph, add a line shape, apply a 20‑degree skew on the X axis, and save the PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

clip-graph-to-rectangle-pdf.title: Clip Graph to Rectangle in PDF
clip-graph-to-rectangle-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to define a clipping region for an Aspose.Pdf Graph by positioning and sizing it to a rectangle, then drawing shapes that exceed the bounds so they are automatically clipped.

add-semi-transparent-rectangle-using-tra.title: Add Semi-Transparent Rectangle Using Graph
add-semi-transparent-rectangle-using-tra.description: Shows how to create a Graph, draw a semi‑transparent rectangle with 50% opacity, and save the result as a PDF.

add-shadow-effect-to-filled-rectangle.title: Add Shadow Effect to a Filled Rectangle in a PDF Graph
add-shadow-effect-to-filled-rectangle.description: Shows how to simulate a shadow for a filled rectangle by drawing an offset semi‑transparent rectangle before the main shape using Aspose.Pdf's Graph container.

create-custom-star-shape-pdf.title: Create Custom Star Shape in PDF
create-custom-star-shape-pdf.description: Demonstrates drawing a star with a configurable number of points and a custom fill color in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf low‑level drawing operators.

add-regular-hexagon-to-pdf-graph.title: Add Hexagonal Polygon to PDF Graph
add-regular-hexagon-to-pdf-graph.description: Demonstrates creating a Graph in a PDF, drawing a regular six‑sided polygon (hexagon) with a Line shape, and setting its border color and thickness.

insert-dashed-polyline-annotation.title: Add Dashed Polyline to PDF Graph
insert-dashed-polyline-annotation.description: Creates a PDF document, adds a graph, and inserts a polyline defined by multiple vertices with a dashed line style.

add-text-inside-graph.title: Add Text Annotation to PDF
add-text-inside-graph.description: Shows how to place a text fragment on a PDF page at specific coordinates while setting font family, size, and color using Aspose.Pdf.

add-background-image-and-graph-to-pdf.title: Add Background Image and Overlay Shapes to PDF
add-background-image-and-graph-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to place a background image on each PDF page using an ImageStamp and then draw shapes (rectangle, ellipse) on top with a Graph object.

insert-scaled-rotated-image-into-pdf.title: Insert and Rotate External Image in PDF
insert-scaled-rotated-image-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an external image, scaling it proportionally to fit within given dimensions, rotating it by a specified angle, and stamping it onto a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-filled-arc-with-radial-gradient.title: Add Filled Arc with Radial Gradient to Graph
add-filled-arc-with-radial-gradient.description: Shows how to create a PDF graph, draw an arc shape, and apply a radial gradient fill using Aspose.Pdf.

create-new-pdf-single-page.title: Create a Single-Page PDF Document
create-new-pdf-single-page.description: Demonstrates how to create a new PDF document, add a default‑size page, and save it using Aspose.Pdf.

add-full-size-graph-to-pdf-page.title: Create a Graph Matching Page Size in PDF
add-full-size-graph-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to instantiate a Graph object with the same width and height as the PDF page, add a shape, and save the document.

add-rectangle-solid-red-fill-to-pdf-grap.title: Add Solid Red Rectangle to PDF Using Graph
add-rectangle-solid-red-fill-to-pdf-grap.description: Demonstrates how to create a Graph container, define a rectangle with absolute coordinates, apply a solid red fill, and add it to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

create-semi-transparent-ellipse-fill.title: Create Semi-Transparent Ellipse in PDF
create-semi-transparent-ellipse-fill.description: Shows how to draw an ellipse with a semi‑transparent fill by using Color.FromArgb to set the alpha channel, and save the result as a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.

insert-centered-textfragment-rectangle.title: Add Centered TextFragment to PDF Rectangle
insert-centered-textfragment-rectangle.description: Demonstrates how to insert a TextFragment with "Hello World" centered inside a defined rectangle on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-shapes-with-bounds-checking.title: Handle Out-of-Bounds Shapes When Adding to PDF Graph
add-shapes-with-bounds-checking.description: Demonstrates how to catch exceptions caused by shapes that exceed page limits, log their coordinates, and add only valid shapes to a Graph in an Aspose.Pdf document.

add-non-overlapping-rectangles-to-pdf-gr.title: Add Non-Overlapping Rectangles to PDF
add-non-overlapping-rectangles-to-pdf-gr.description: Creates a PDF, adds a Graph container, and draws multiple rectangles of varying sizes while checking bounds to prevent any overlap before adding each shape.

create-graph-with-rectangle-and-ellipse.title: Create Graph with Shapes and Gradient Fills in PDF
create-graph-with-rectangle-and-ellipse.description: Demonstrates how to build a Graph containing rectangles and ellipses with solid, linear gradient, radial gradient, and simulated hatch fills, and add it to a PDF page.

export-pdf-to-memorystream-and-save-to-f.title: Export PDF to MemoryStream and Save to Disk
export-pdf-to-memorystream-and-save-to-f.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, saving it into a MemoryStream, and then writing the stream contents to a file on disk.

add-graph-with-shapes-to-pdf.title: Add Graph with Shapes to a New PDF Page
add-graph-with-shapes-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an existing PDF, adding a blank page, creating a Graph object, drawing basic shapes (line, ellipse, rectangle) on it, and saving the updated document.

add-graph-rectangle-watermark-to-pdf.title: Insert Identical Graph and Watermark into Multiple PDFs
add-graph-rectangle-watermark-to-pdf.description: The example iterates over PDF files in a folder, adds the same chart (Graph) and a semi‑transparent watermark rectangle to each document, and saves the modified files to an output directory.

add-gradient-ellipse-graphs-to-pdfs.title: Add Gradient Ellipses to PDFs in Parallel
add-gradient-ellipse-graphs-to-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to process multiple PDF files concurrently with Parallel.ForEach and add a graph containing gradient‑filled ellipses to each document using Aspose.Pdf.

configure-graph-border-add-rectangle.title: Add Custom Dashed Borders to PDF Page Using Graph
configure-graph-border-add-rectangle.description: Loads an existing PDF, creates a Graph that covers the page, sets line width and dash style, and draws outer and inner rectangular borders with custom margins.

build-reusable-graph-for-pdf-pages.title: Create Predefined Graph on PDF Page
build-reusable-graph-for-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to build a predefined graph with a title, rectangle, ellipse, and line, add it to a PDF page, and return the Graph object for further customization.

serialize-pdf-graph-to-byte-array.title: Create Graph in PDF and Serialize to Byte Array
serialize-pdf-graph-to-byte-array.description: The example creates a PDF document, adds a Graph with a line series and axes, and then serializes the PDF to a byte array for network transmission.

toggle-graph-bounds-check-mode.title: Toggle Graph BoundsCheckMode in Aspose.Pdf
toggle-graph-bounds-check-mode.description: Demonstrates how to switch the Graph.BoundsCheckMode between throwing an exception and ignoring out‑of‑bounds shapes based on a user setting, and adds a sample shape to a PDF page.

create-bar-graph-with-legend.title: Generate PDF Report with Bar Graph and Legend
create-bar-graph-with-legend.description: Creates a PDF document that contains a simple bar graph made of colored rectangles and a corresponding legend, demonstrating basic drawing and text placement with Aspose.Pdf.

add-rounded-rectangle-with-fill.title: Add Rounded Rectangle Annotation with Fill to PDF
add-rounded-rectangle-with-fill.description: Shows how to create a square annotation with rounded corners, apply a solid fill color, and add it to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

create-rotate-ellipse-pdf-graph.title: Create a Rotated Ellipse in a PDF
create-rotate-ellipse-pdf-graph.description: Demonstrates how to draw an ellipse, rotate it 45 degrees using GraphInfo, and embed it in a PDF document with Aspose.Pdf.

combine-multiple-graphs-pdf-collage.title: Create PDF Collage of Multiple Images
combine-multiple-graphs-pdf-collage.description: Demonstrates how to place several image files on a single PDF page at specific coordinates using Aspose.Pdf, forming a collage layout.

add-semi-transparent-rectangle.title: Add Gradient Rectangle with Transparency to PDF
add-semi-transparent-rectangle.description: Creates a PDF with a rectangle filled by a linear gradient that fades from fully transparent to fully opaque, demonstrating alpha channel usage in Aspose.Pdf.

measure-ellipse-bounding-box.title: Measure Ellipse Bounding Box with Gradient Fill in PDF
measure-ellipse-bounding-box.description: Demonstrates how to draw an ellipse inside a Graph, apply a fill color, and retrieve its bounding box coordinates in an Aspose.Pdf document.

create-multi-page-pdf-with-full-page-gra.title: Create Multi‑Page PDF with Full‑Page Graphs
create-multi-page-pdf-with-full-page-gra.description: Shows how to generate a PDF with several pages where each page contains a graph that fills the page, including axes and a simple bar chart.

configure-shape-fill-colors-json-pdf-gra.title: Configure Shape Fill Colors from JSON for PDF Graph
configure-shape-fill-colors-json-pdf-gra.description: Demonstrates loading a JSON configuration to set default fill colors for rectangle and circle shapes, then creating a PDF with those colored shapes using Aspose.Pdf.

add-dashed-rectangle-to-graph.title: Add Dashed Rectangle Annotation to PDF Graph
add-dashed-rectangle-to-graph.description: Shows how to place a rectangle with a 2‑point dashed border over an existing graph in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

test-out-of-bounds-rectangle-throws-exce.title: Out‑of‑Bounds Rectangle Throws ArgumentException
test-out-of-bounds-rectangle-throws-exce.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF, adding a Graph with a rectangle that exceeds page bounds, and asserting that Aspose.Pdf throws an ArgumentException.

batch-insert-company-logo-graph-into-pdf.title: Insert Graph Image and Logo Rectangle into PDFs
batch-insert-company-logo-graph-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to batch‑process PDF files, adding a predefined graph image and a logo rectangle (as a text stamp) to the first page of each document using Aspose.PDF.

create-pdf-with-graph.title: Create PDF with Column Chart in Memory
create-pdf-with-graph.description: Shows how to generate a PDF document in memory, draw a simple column chart using Aspose.Pdf Graph primitives, and return the PDF as a byte array.

create-proportional-graphs-pdf.title: Create PDF with Proportional Graphs on Each Page
create-proportional-graphs-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF where each page contains a graph with axes, a bar, and a circle sized proportionally to the page dimensions using Aspose.Pdf.

map-shape-identifiers-to-fill-colors.title: Map Shape IDs to Fill Colors in PDF Graph
map-shape-identifiers-to-fill-colors.description: Shows how to use a dictionary to associate shape identifiers with fill colors and apply those colors when creating rectangle, circle, and ellipse shapes inside an Aspose.Pdf Graph.

ellipse-with-transparent-fill-and-center.title: Add Ellipse with Border and Centered Text to PDF
ellipse-with-transparent-fill-and-center.description: Demonstrates how to draw an ellipse with a thick border and semi‑transparent fill, then place a centered text fragment inside it using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-graph-styled-text.title: Create PDF Graph with Shapes and Text Using Different Fonts
create-pdf-graph-styled-text.description: Demonstrates generating a PDF that contains a graph with rectangle, ellipse, line, and triangle shapes, each labeled with a TextFragment using various fonts and sizes.

scale-graph-shapes-150-percent.title: Scale Shapes in a Graph by 150% Using Transform Property
scale-graph-shapes-150-percent.description: Demonstrates how to apply a 150 % scaling transform to rectangle and ellipse shapes within an Aspose.Pdf Graph before rendering the graph onto a PDF page.

add-rectangle-with-shadow-to-pdf.title: Add Rectangle with Shadow to PDF
add-rectangle-with-shadow-to-pdf.description: Shows how to draw a rectangle with a semi‑transparent offset shadow in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's drawing API.

create-pdf-graph-border-colors.title: Create PDF Graph with Shape Border Colors from Lookup Table
create-pdf-graph-border-colors.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF containing a graph where each shape's border color is derived from a dictionary lookup table.

insert-graph-into-pdf-footer.title: Create Footer Graph in PDF with Aspose.Pdf
insert-graph-into-pdf-footer.description: Demonstrates how to set page margins, position a Graph object in the footer area, draw a simple column chart with axes and bars, add a title, and save the PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

create-horizontal-bar-chart-pdf.title: Create Horizontal Bar Chart with Rectangles
create-horizontal-bar-chart-pdf.description: Shows how to generate a PDF containing a simple horizontal bar chart by drawing ten rectangles with incremental X coordinates using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-graph-filled-outline-shapes.title: Create PDF with Filled and Stroke‑Only Shapes Using Aspose.Pdf Graph
create-pdf-graph-filled-outline-shapes.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF containing both filled shapes and stroke‑only outlines by using Aspose.Pdf's Graph and drawing primitives.

export-graph-to-pdf.title: Create and Export a Bar Chart to PDF
export-graph-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to build a simple bar‑chart using Aspose.Pdf's Graph container and export it as a PDF document.

add-circle-to-pdf-graph-gradient.title: Insert Gradient Filled Circle into PDF Graph
add-circle-to-pdf-graph-gradient.description: Shows how to add a Graph to a PDF page and draw a circle with a radial gradient fill using two colors.

add-filled-ellipse-with-gradient-to-pdf-.title: Add Filled Ellipse with Gradient to PDF Graph
add-filled-ellipse-with-gradient-to-pdf-.description: Demonstrates how to draw an ellipse inside a Graph container and fill it with a vertical axial gradient in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-polygon-gradient-fill-dashed-outline.title: Add Polygon to PDF Graph with Dashed Outline
add-polygon-gradient-fill-dashed-outline.description: Creates a PDF document, adds a Graph object, draws a closed polygon using a Line shape, fills it with a solid color (simulating a pattern), and applies a dashed outline to the polygon.

apply-linear-gradient-ellipse.title: Apply Linear Gradient Fill to an Ellipse in a PDF Graph
apply-linear-gradient-ellipse.description: Shows how to create a Graph, add an Ellipse shape, and fill it with a blue‑to‑green axial gradient using Aspose.Pdf.

ellipse-gradient-dark-gray-border.title: Apply Radial Gradient to Ellipse with Dark Gray Border
ellipse-gradient-dark-gray-border.description: Shows how to draw an ellipse in a PDF, fill it with a radial gradient, and set a dark gray stroke using Aspose.Pdf.

set-rectangle-fill-opacity-argb.title: Set Rectangle Fill Opacity Using ARGB in PDF
set-rectangle-fill-opacity-argb.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add a rectangle with 50% fill opacity using an ARGB color value, verify the color components, and save/load the document.

deserialize-pdf-add-labeled-graph.title: Deserialize PDF and Add Column Chart with Labels
deserialize-pdf-add-labeled-graph.description: Loads a PDF from a byte array, creates a Graph object to draw a column chart with axes, bars, and text labels, then saves the updated PDF.

clip-shapes-within-rectangle-graph.title: Clip Shapes Within a Rectangle Using Graph
clip-shapes-within-rectangle-graph.description: Demonstrates creating a Graph that spans the whole page, adding large shapes, and shows that the Graph class does not provide a Clip property for restricting drawing to a rectangle.

add-square-annotations-with-bounds-valid.title: Add Rectangle Shape with Bounds Error Logging to PDF
add-square-annotations-with-bounds-valid.description: Demonstrates how to draw a rectangle on a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf and logs detailed coordinate information when bounds checking throws an exception.

create-ellipse-with-pattern-fill.title: Create Ellipse with Custom Fill in PDF
create-ellipse-with-pattern-fill.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF document, add an ellipse shape, assign a fill color (as a placeholder for a pattern brush), verify the fill assignment, and save the file using Aspose.Pdf.

create-radial-gradient-rectangle.title: Add Rectangle with Radial Gradient to PDF
create-radial-gradient-rectangle.description: Shows how to draw a rectangle filled with a radial gradient that transitions from opaque red at the centre to transparent edges on an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

clone-rectangle-change-fill-and-add.title: Clone Rectangle, Change Fill Color, and Add to Graph
clone-rectangle-change-fill-and-add.description: Shows how to duplicate an Aspose.Pdf.Drawing.Rectangle, modify its fill color, and insert the cloned shape into a Graph on a PDF page.

add-ellipse-gradient-simulation-center-v.title: Add Ellipse with Gradient Fill and Verify Center
add-ellipse-gradient-simulation-center-v.description: Creates a PDF, adds an ellipse shape filled with a radial gradient (as a stand‑in for a conical gradient), and verifies that the gradient origin matches the ellipse's center.

apply-texture-brush-to-ellipse.title: Apply a Texture Brush to an Ellipse in a PDF
apply-texture-brush-to-ellipse.description: Demonstrates how to load an image file as a texture brush and use it to fill an ellipse shape in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf drawing objects.

add-filled-curve-with-opacity-and-border.title: Add Filled Curve with Opacity and Border to PDF
add-filled-curve-with-opacity-and-border.description: Shows how to draw a Bezier curve on a PDF page, apply a semi‑transparent fill color and set the border thickness using Aspose.Pdf.

enable-bounds-check-mode-graph.title: Validate Graph Shape Placement with BoundsCheckMode
enable-bounds-check-mode-graph.description: Creates a PDF document containing a Graph, enables BoundsCheckMode.ThrowExceptionIfDoesNotFit to ensure added shapes fit within the graph area, adds a rectangle, and saves the file. An out‑of‑bounds shape (commented) would trigger an exception, demonstrating validation.

graph-overlapping-shapes-bounds-check.title: Create Graph with Overlapping Shapes and Bounds Checking
graph-overlapping-shapes-bounds-check.description: Demonstrates how to add a Graph to a PDF, place overlapping rectangle and ellipse shapes with transparency, and use BoundsCheckMode to detect shapes that exceed the graph area.

add-graph-to-pdf.title: Add Bar Graph to PDF Using Aspose.Pdf
add-graph-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, create a simple bar‑graph with a Table and Graph shapes, and save the updated document.
